summary: Contribution by Kristian Muri Knausgård. Policy v2 (RH foundation). The proof of knausgard-rh-bui-heath-brown (a full Lean proof, from RiemannHypothesis, of Bui and Heath-Brown's theorem that 19/27 of the zeros are simple, with the third-moment certificate for distinct zeros), with the window re-tuned at degree 40 instead of 14. N_d ≥ (0.850881905915655942916451493668659468971332872739 − o(1))·N, the exact value rounded down to 48 decimals. This is a re-optimisation (gain 3.7e-20), not new mathematics: numerically the score is 1.6e-49 below the supremum over even polynomial windows, and odd perturbations do not help. The cubic certificate is due to Claude (Anthropic) and Alpöge–Furman (arXiv:2608.13637, §7.3); the shifted form and 0.8508819 are in Josu San Martin's note of 21 November 2026. 186 modules (4 MB), carried compressed and decoded by a plain-text command in the file; see the header.
method: Formal Bui-Heath-Brown 19/27 + third-moment certificate as in knausgard-rh-bui-heath-brown; window re-tuned at degree 40 (1.6e-49 below the supremum).
